edits.modify_from: add 1 if the execution steps shown at this step contain the cube marked 'is held in the gripper' and then, later in the same step, the fingers opened to about 100% with the gripper low (height below about 0.03) and the cube now lying at roughly the target's position, no longer held. Otherwise keep the carried value unchanged. Never decrease it. e.g. 1
edits.modify_to: add 1 if BOTH hold: (a) at least one execution frame shown at this step has the goal-colored cube marked 'is held in the gripper', and (b) in the final scene of this step the goal-colored cube is NOT marked held, the fingers are about 100% open, and the cube lies within a few pixels of the target position. Do not require any particular finger percentage or gripper height at an intermediate frame; a release frame may show fingers only 80-90% open with the cube still marked held, and that still counts once the final scene meets (b). Do not add 1 if the cube was never marked held during this step (a missed grasp, even if the cube already rests on the target from before), or if the final scene shows the cube held. Otherwise keep the carried value unchanged. Never decrease it. e.g. 2
